posts.raw_content:
My brother and I played sports at an athletic association from the time we were 4 or 5. Eventually my dad got a seat on the board as the Field Maintenance Director. He got to hire some kids (me and my friends) to do the grunt work and we got paid under the table it was a sweet gig for a 12 year old.  

My Dad also coached travel baseball at the time for my brothers team. 

One day my Dad was doing some work lining baseball fields at 6am on a Saturday to prepare for the day. Another travel coach of a younger team, first year coaching, came up to him and said hey I want to use this field for my game today. My Dad said no that's not the schedule you're on this other field. Left it at that. 

Dad went home and showered, got my brother ready and went for his game that day. He shows up to the field and the other guy has his team on it already. 

My Dad went to the schedule guy and said wtf. He basically just shrugged. 

So my Dad brought it up at the next board meeting. Said it was BS. The board, 15 tiny hats and 2 Christians, decided not to pursue the matter. Then my Dad found out on the way out the coach of the other team also wore a tiny hat. That was the last straw for him. He resigned from the board that day. 

Now Dads an old man, not in great health....doesn't remember a lot of things. But he remembers that. Ask him about it and he'll talk your ear off like he's writing a sequel to Mein Kumph. Says they stuck together and sided with the tiny hat coach because that's what they do. 

About a year later he got passed over for a big promotion at work after the guy said he had the job. He shows up one day and gets introduced to his new boss....a black dude. He asks the hiring guy wtf the guy says oh well they made me hire a colored. Dad transferred and then took early retirement two years later. Still bitter about that too. Can't blame him.

Anyway, just a story....
